run_merge_traj_main: run the merge_traj script to merge VASP checkpoint trajectories into a single full trajectory file
extract_file_from_zip: extract a specific file from a zip archive to a target directory using extract_file
merge_vasp_checkpoints: merge intermediate VASP relaxation checkpoints into a single ASE trajectory file for an adsorbate run
read_vasp_xml_trajectory: read VASP vasprun.xml files and construct an ASE trajectory using ase.io.read with vasp-xml format
write_full_trajectory: write a merged ASE trajectory to a .traj file using ase.io.write for adsorbate relaxation outputs
